sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Secretariat of the National Assembly comprising such offices in the Government service as the President may direct. (2) The Secretariat of the National Assembly shall have such number and grades of staff as may from time to time be determined by the relevant Service Commission after consultation with the Clerk of the National Assembly. (3) The Secretariat of the National Assembly, under the leadership of the Clerk, shall carry out all functions and activities prescribed or necessary for ensuring the effective exercise by Parliament and Members of Parliament of the powers of Parliament under this Constitution.
